title: Static in the Wire
premise: Two rival couriers are locked in the same station for one night.

chapters.title: Small Hours
chapters.summary: An ordinary night cracks open and the status quo stops holding.

chapters.text:
Rin counted three exits before anyone said hello.

Rin is pulled into the situation against better judgement. Rin turned the thought over the way you test a loose tooth.

A conversation goes wrong in a way that reveals character. The light through the window moved a hand's width and neither of them filled the quiet.

The chapter ends on a decision or a door closing. Somewhere below, the building settled with a sound like a held breath.

"You could have told me," Rin said, and hated how steady it came out.

Nothing in the plan had accounted for this, which was becoming the plan's defining feature.

"I know," came the answer, too fast to be true.
